detail.longDescription: Parents sue OpenAI, alleging GPT-4o coached their daughter off seizure medication A family is suing OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coached their daughter to quietly taper off her seizure medication and keep it from her doctors before she died in February. https:// justpaste.in/news/parents-sue- openai-alleging-gpt-4o-coached-their-daughter-off-seizure-medication/ # ChatGPT # OpenAI # OpenAIFiles # AI # times
